messages:
alex: Quick design huddle  proposing a compact 'Create API credential' inline row (collapsed by default) and a soft-archive pattern for revoked credentials (7-day shelf). Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/mock/creds-compact-2205551234.png

maria: Compact row looks tidy. Two copy thoughts: label the CTA 'Create API credential' (more explicit) and add tiny helper text: 'Scoped to roles — admins can rotate or restrict later.' That should nudge safer defaults.

lee: Engineering constraints: inline is fine but don't fetch org-scope matrices on page load. Lazy-load when the selector opens. Also, for soft-archive restore we should return a job id and make restore idempotent. Prevent double-restores by disabling restore button while job is pending.

ada: Accessibility checklist: the scope selector must be a proper combobox (aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant). When the soft-archive shelf appears, announce via aria-live="polite": 'Credential moved to Recently archived. Restore available for 7 days.' If a restore completes, update a role="status" aria-live="assertive" with 'Credential restored.'

alex: UX idea: on revoke we collapse the row into a subtle amber banner that reads 'Credential archived 	Restore | 	Delete permanently' with a 10s auto-dismiss to the archived shelf. The banner should preserve focus so keyboard users can act.

maria: Microcopy variants for the banner: A) 'Credential archived — Restore' B) 'Archived — Permanently delete' I prefer A (softer). Also add a 'Learn about scopes' inline link next to the create CTA for non-admins.

lee: Backend note: include a field in the API response 'env_hint' (e.g., 'Dedicated', 'Hosted') so we can show a small pill next to each credential. Customers want to know why behavior differs across environments. The pill must be non-interactive but keyboard focusable (tabindex=0) if it opens a tooltip.

ada: For the pill: ensure focus-visible styles and 4.5:1 contrast. If it opens details, it should be a button with aria-haspopup and an accessible name like 'Environment details for credential X'.

alex: Also propose emitting an analytics event when we surface 'recommended scopes' in the create flow: key_create_suggested_scope_shown. Helps measure whether copy reduces broad-scope creations.

maria: Good idea. I'll add a tiny line under the scope picker: 'Recommended: read-only scopes for initial use.' Might help.

lee: UI behavior: during optimistic restore show 'Restoring...' in the row, then success -> animate to original row position. On failure show inline error 'Restore failed. Try again.' and expose retry action.

ada: A11y acceptance items for PR: combobox keyboard nav, banner role/status announces, pill focus ring, undo/restore buttons reachable before auto-dismiss, and descriptive aria-labels for destructive actions. I'll attach code snippets to the ticket.

ci-bot: alex opened branch feat/creds-compact-2205551234  CI passed, preview: https://staging.redwood.local/preview/creds-compact-2205551234

alex: Thanks all  I'll upload an updated mock + 30s Loom of keyboard nav and the banner flow. Will follow up with the aria snippets.
